title: Rethinking "Batch" in BatchNorm
mechanism: Review of BN caveats from batch choices (train vs population stats, precise BN, frozen BN in fine-tuning, domain-specific stats) and their fixes.
adaptation: Batch 8 with 5 mixed sources: test encoder BN frozen at ImageNet stats, precise-BN recompute on train before eval, and both. Required plumbing for EMA, SWAD, WiSE-FT, LiNeS arms.
evidence: Review with mitigations in visual recognition (abstract).
min_experiment: Precise BN on existing checkpoints (zero training), then frozen-BN arm vs PF seeds 5-9. Kill if val relF1@2 change < +0.005.
prior_overlap: Partial: per-panel BN adaptation at test time failed; training-time BN choices never varied.

alt_notes.adaptation: Batch 8 mixes 5 sources: test (a) encoder BN frozen at ImageNet stats, (b) precise-BN recompute on train before eval, (c) both. Needed plumbing for weight averaging arms.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: (b) free on existing checkpoints; (a) and (c) 5 seeds. Baseline: SUP100-PF. Metric: test crack relF1@2, E1 crack relF1@2. Kill: all within noise.
